summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV, a Belgian-domiciled Nasdaq/Euronext-listed biotech, filed a Form 6-K disclosing buyback purchases under its June 9, 2026 repurchase program. Between September 7 and 11, 2026, it repurchased 125,517 ordinary shares through a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary, at an average of EUR 23.95 for EUR 3,005,545 total, ranging EUR 23.20–24.56. Following settlement, Lakefront holds 1,418,855 treasury shares. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock stated. Watch pace of further repurchases and treasury share buildup for capital-allocation signals.
